newsitem.title: FRANCE: Prince says Spain determined to join EMU.
newsitem.headline: Prince says Spain determined to join EMU.

text.p: Crown Prince Felipe of Spain told his French hosts on Tuesday his country was determined to fulfill the criteria needed to join the European single currency, French officials said.
The 28-year-old prince, the son of King Juan Carlos, made his comments in talks with French Senate speaker Rene Monory on the second day of an official visit to France.
He also called for the European Union to open up to its eastern neighbours and pay more attention to poor countries south of the Mediterranean.
But he urged caution on diverting EU aid towards outside countries as some EU members like Spain needed the aid.

The Spanish government has drafted an austerity budget which it hopes will place Spain among the first group of countries to join a European single currency, a key platform of the ruling conservatives' campaign in last March's general election.

Prince Felipe, on his first official call on a major power, was also meeting National Assembly speaker Philippe Seguin and Paris mayor Jean Tiberi. He was due to attend a dinner hosted by Prime Minister Alain Juppe and have talks on Wednesday with President Jacques Chirac.
